newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia January vehicle sales said 30,106 units.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia January vehicle sales said 30,106 units.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automobile maker PT Astra International said on Friday the country's total vehicle sales in January were 30,106 units, compared with 31,161 units last December.
A total of 28,974 vehicles were sold in January last year.
Astra said in a monthly statistical report passenger car sales rose to 5,588 units in January from 4,335 units in December, and compared with 3,877 units in January last year.
But it said commercial vehicle sales fell to 24,242 units in January from 26,401 units in December and against 24,758 units in January last year.
A total of 276 vehicles were exported in January.
Astra's market share improved to 47.12 percent in January from 46.54 percent in December. Astra had a market share of 50 percent last year, compared with 54.95 percent in 1995.
Astra said Indonesian motorcycle sales, including exports, amounted to 136,548 units in January against 108,621 units in December and compared with 104,707 units in January last year.
Astra, the agent for Japan's Honda, had a market share of 48.75 percent in January against 43.7 percent in December.
Total motorcycle sales in 1996 were 1,377,206 units in 1996, compared with 984,419 units in 1995.
